propositions: A plan asserts that a named module provides a capability, but the module lacks that capability (dc58: signing not in completion.py; db7b: compaction does not handle REVIEW_RESULT)
A plan asserts that a capability is absent and must be built, but the module already provides it (5886: fetcher.py already emits unmapped-jira-status alert)
A new advisory, code-grounded, agent-tier criterion must be added to the G6/E4 rubric family with entry in registry, routing, and rubric to detect capability-surface mismatches
The criterion ships in advisory posture only; promotion to blocking is a future dogfood-gated decision per the advisory-to-blocking promotion gate protocol
The criterion auto-integrates with the standing criterion-effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring
Bounded sanity check must show >=2/3 recall on the three verified misses (dc58, db7b, 5886) and no blocking false positives on clean plans
